description: BUYCOR crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C81 H55 Cl1 Dy3 N9 O9,3(C1 H4 O1),H2 O1. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.536-3.541 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.97-99.01°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy3(ql)8Cl(Hql)]·3CH3OH·H2O (Hql = 8-hydroxyquinoline).
